# kashi

> Reusable, updatable building blocks for apps on Cloudflare Workers + D1 (Hono), React + Tailwind v4, and Flutter, plus the Agent Skills that teach AI coding agents how to use them. Each feature ships as one package bundling every layer (server, web, Flutter), so a single version bump updates the API routes and the UI together.

Start with `skills/kashi/SKILL.md` — it is the index and holds the conventions every package follows. `AGENTS.md` is the canonical guide for working in this repository.

## Docs

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): canonical guide for extending packages, layering rules, versioning, and testing conventions
- [README.md](README.md): project overview, package/skill table, install and usage commands

## Packages

- [packages/core/README.md](packages/core/README.md): request envelope, errors, crypto, ids, rate limits, API client (`@softwareseva/core` / `kashi_core`)
- [packages/auth/README.md](packages/auth/README.md): sessions, WhatsApp OTP, Google, Apple, passkeys (`@softwareseva/auth` / `kashi_auth`)
- [packages/list/README.md](packages/list/README.md): keyset pagination, search, sort, DataTable (`@softwareseva/list` / `kashi_list`)
- [packages/sync/README.md](packages/sync/README.md): offline sync outbox and push/pull (`@softwareseva/sync` / `kashi_sync`)
- [packages/ui/README.md](packages/ui/README.md): design tokens and themed primitives (`@softwareseva/ui` / `kashi_ui`)
- [packages/tokens/README.md](packages/tokens/README.md): shared design tokens, source of truth for `ui`'s CSS and Dart theme
- [packages/cli/README.md](packages/cli/README.md): `@softwareseva/cli` — init, add, update, secrets, doctor

## Secrets

Step-by-step generation instructions for every secret a package or CLI deploy module needs (paired with the `secrets.json` each ships, which `npx @softwareseva/cli secrets` reads):

- [packages/auth/SECRETS.md](packages/auth/SECRETS.md): sessions, WhatsApp/SMS/email OTP, Google, Apple, Facebook, passkeys, peer federation
- [packages/cli/templates/modules/deploy-cloudflare/SECRETS.md](packages/cli/templates/modules/deploy-cloudflare/SECRETS.md): Cloudflare API token and account id for CI deploys
- [packages/cli/templates/modules/deploy-fastlane/SECRETS.md](packages/cli/templates/modules/deploy-fastlane/SECRETS.md): App Store Connect API key, fastlane match, Android keystore, Play service account

## Skills

- [skills/kashi/SKILL.md](skills/kashi/SKILL.md): index and conventions for the whole toolkit — read first
- [skills/hono-d1-api/SKILL.md](skills/hono-d1-api/SKILL.md): build or extend a Hono API on Workers + D1

- [skills/flutter-api-client/SKILL.md](skills/flutter-api-client/SKILL.md): call a kashi API from Flutter
- [skills/auth-sessions/SKILL.md](skills/auth-sessions/SKILL.md): sign-in and sessions on a Hono API — start here before provider-specific auth skills
- [skills/auth-google/SKILL.md](skills/auth-google/SKILL.md): Google sign-in for web and mobile
- [skills/auth-apple/SKILL.md](skills/auth-apple/SKILL.md): Sign in with Apple for web and iOS
- [skills/auth-facebook/SKILL.md](skills/auth-facebook/SKILL.md): Facebook Login for web and mobile
- [skills/auth-passkeys/SKILL.md](skills/auth-passkeys/SKILL.md): passkey sign-in and sign-up
- [skills/auth-whatsapp-otp/SKILL.md](skills/auth-whatsapp-otp/SKILL.md): phone/email OTP sign-in over WhatsApp, SMS, or email
- [skills/auth-federation/SKILL.md](skills/auth-federation/SKILL.md): cross-site single sign-on between kashi sites
- [skills/auth-identity-extensions/SKILL.md](skills/auth-identity-extensions/SKILL.md): multi-channel OTP, account linking, recovery codes, session revocation
- [skills/flutter-auth/SKILL.md](skills/flutter-auth/SKILL.md): sign-in for Flutter apps
- [skills/d1-list-pagination/SKILL.md](skills/d1-list-pagination/SKILL.md): paginated, searchable, sortable list endpoints on D1
- [skills/react-data-table/SKILL.md](skills/react-data-table/SKILL.md): directory/admin table screens in React
- [skills/sync-endpoints/SKILL.md](skills/sync-endpoints/SKILL.md): server side of offline-first sync
- [skills/flutter-drift-sync/SKILL.md](skills/flutter-drift-sync/SKILL.md): offline-first data in Flutter with Drift
- [skills/react-offline-sync/SKILL.md](skills/react-offline-sync/SKILL.md): offline-first data in React with RxDB
- [skills/kashi-ui-web/SKILL.md](skills/kashi-ui-web/SKILL.md): style a React app with the kashi design system
- [skills/kashi-ui-flutter/SKILL.md](skills/kashi-ui-flutter/SKILL.md): style a Flutter app with the kashi design system
- [skills/deploy-cloudflare/SKILL.md](skills/deploy-cloudflare/SKILL.md): deploy a Hono Worker (and web app) to Cloudflare from GitHub Actions
- [skills/deploy-flutter-fastlane/SKILL.md](skills/deploy-flutter-fastlane/SKILL.md): ship a Flutter app to TestFlight and Google Play
